note: Re-judged 2026-11-08 (independent auditor) after 25a0665638: the tests build the resolver with Servers: []string{addr} instead of Server: addr, and Resolver.query now asks each server in turn through queryServer, which sets SetEdns0(4096, validating) on every query (resolver.go:418) and applies dnssecDecision to every answer. With one server the tagged units drive the same path. A SERVFAIL refused by DNSSEC policy is not an unansweredError, so it is not passed to a next server; the AD/CD assertions are unchanged. Prior judgement: Re-judged 2026-09-30. Both bits now: under strict validation a NOERROR answer with AD=1 CD=1 yields exactly the records of the clear answer (a resolver requiring or honouring AD would differ), and SERVFAIL with AD, CD or both is refused, so no response bit lets a failure through. Records: query (+) and dnssecDecision (-) reverts observed red.
